method.aggregate_metrics: Tracking and jitter use all environments over complete duration: motion 4 envs x 42s; standing 1 env x 120s.
method.window_metrics: Telemetry env0 only; motion excludes first second of each six-second command segment; standing includes explicitly named windows, primary comparison 40 <= t < 120 seconds.
method.action_delta: Per-axis pooled RMS of consecutive action differences; first8 leg position targets, last2 wheel velocity targets in configured order.
method.heading: Unwrapped yaw from wxyz root quaternion, separate from body yaw rate.
method.reset_rule: Record done/timeout counts; displacement interpreted only with no resets.
method.velocity_estimator: Latest independently trained policy disables explicit head, actor velocity block and velocity supervision. History latent remains. Missing estimator metrics are not zero error.

limitations: Same seed42, matching scenarios and reward configuration; no multi-seed evaluation by user preference.
Two independently trained models; architecture and auxiliary supervision change together when the flag is disabled.
No approved convergence criteria or hardware validation.
Noisy standing failures here do not quantify the behavior at actual hardware sensor noise levels.
